# People Consulting

> Leading Corporate HR Consulting, Executive Search, Talent Acquisition, Labor Compliance, and Corporate Training Firm.

## About People Consulting
People Consulting helps organizations optimize their HR strategies, talent acquisition pipelines, statutory labor compliance, and executive leadership development.

## Core HR Services
- [Hiring & Staffing](https://peopleconsultings.com/services/hiring-staffing): End-to-end recruitment solutions to find top talent.
- [Executive Search](https://peopleconsultings.com/services/executive-search): High-caliber leadership recruitment for senior executive roles.
- [Labor Compliance](https://peopleconsultings.com/services/labor-compliance): Statutory labor law adherence and audit frameworks.
- [Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO)](https://peopleconsultings.com/services/recruitment-process-outsourcing-rpo): Dedicated recruitment management for scaling enterprises.
